description: Enhanced coverage for the freemarker (expression-and-directive) engine: a valid template merged with a different model value confirms the substitution is data-driven rather than fixed; a template whose extension is 'html' (a real, engine-specific extension rather than the native 'unknownext') is rejected as an invalid template name; and an empty-string template reference (as opposed to the native whitespace-only reference) is likewise rejected as invalid.
